Problem Statement
Read two integers a and b. Using functions, print the square of a, a raised to the power b, b raised to the power a, and the larger of a and b.
Description
Read two integers a and b. Write a function that finds the power of a number. If the exponent is not given, the function must find the square of the number. Using this function, print the square of a, the value of a raised to the power b, and the value of b raised to the power a. Also print the larger of a and b.
Input Description
Two integers a and b, each on a separate line. (1 <= a, b <= 10)
Output Description
Print 4 lines: the square of a, a raised to the power b, b raised to the power a, and the larger of a and b. If a and b are equal, print that number as the larger number.
